{
  "version":"2.6.2",
  "updated":"2026-09-07",
  "name":"Tim Dooley Atlas — Unified Manifest",
  "purpose":"The canonical map of the repository. Internal datasets remain modular, but the atlas presents them as one system with stable layers, routes, record identity, relationships, entanglement and evidence.",
  "public_application_root":"/TimDooley/",
  "public_url":"https://thepotatooflife.github.io/TimDooley/",
  "principle":"One atlas, many layers. Records are the objects; relationships explain how they connect; entanglement explains coupling, topology and trajectory; evidence explains what is known; architecture explains where things belong.",
  "frontend_bridge":"data/frontend-atlas-bridge.json",
  "country_fallback":"data/country-fallback.json",
  "cross_domain_couplings":"data/cross-domain-couplings.json",
  "multiplication_registry":"data/atlas-multiplication-registry.json",
  "multiplication_round_01":"data/atlas-multiplication-round-01.json",
  "population_pass":"data/population-pass-2026-09.json",
  "record_model":{"entanglement":["strength","dependency","distance","feedback","topology","trajectory","phase"]},
  "layers":{
    "architecture":{"label":"Architecture","files":["data/frame.json","data/tree.json","data/33-level-framework.json","data/axis-topology.json","data/tree-concept-records.json"]},
    "graph":{"label":"Graph","files":["data/nodes.json","data/relationships.json","data/graph-registry.json","data/graph-carvings.json","data/evidence/relationships.json","data/entanglement.json","data/global-graph-bridge.json","data/atlas-multiplication-registry.json","data/atlas-multiplication-round-01.json"]},
    "world":{"label":"World","files":["data/countries/index.json","data/country-static.json","data/country-atlas.json","data/country-nodes.json","data/country-layer-manifest.json","data/indicator-catalog.json","data/indicator-source-matrix.json","data/country-fallback.json"]},
    "research":{"label":"Evidence","files":["data/research.json","data/events.json","data/country-source-registry.json","data/evidence/observations.json","data/evidence/missing-data.json","data/evidence-map.json","data/research-frontier.json","data/population-pass-2026-09.json"]},
    "systems":{"label":"Systems","files":["data/european-sector-atlas.json","data/north-europe-system-atlas.json","data/north-europe-economic-network.json","data/european-system-observations-2026-09.json","data/indicator-catalog.json","data/expansion-registry.json","data/atlas-expansion-matrix.json"]},
    "security":{"label":"Security, Intelligence and Extremism","files":["data/security-intelligence-organizations.json","data/security-intelligence-country-layer.json","data/intelligence-security-graph.json","data/extremist-hate-groups.json","data/extremism-terrorism-nrm-expansion.json"]},
    "beliefs":{"label":"Beliefs and Religion","files":["data/belief-backend.json","data/belief-registry.json","data/belief-records.json","data/belief-integrity.json","data/religious-layer-manifest.json","data/religious-layer-map.json","data/religious-dimensions.json","data/religious-lexicon.json","data/religious-foundations.json","data/religious-comparative-library.json","data/religious-relationships.json","data/religious-category-records.json","data/canonical-texts.json"]},
    "emotion":{"label":"Emotion and State","files":["data/hawkins-scale.json","hawkins.html"]},
    "mythology":{"label":"Potatoism","files":["data/potatoverse-lore.json","data/potato-properties.json","data/potato-spatial-map.json","data/potato-research-roadmap.json","data/potatoism-religion.json","data/potatoism-cosmology.json","data/potatoism-lexicon.json","data/potatoism-relationships.json","data/potatoism-research-expansion.json","data/potatoism-atlas-navigation.json","data/mythic-ontology.json","data/tim-dooley-cosmology.json","data/potatoism-canonical-corpus.json","data/potatoism-timeline.json","data/potatoism-lexicon-expanded.json","data/potatoism-concept-map.json","data/potatoism-thalamus-brain-map.json","data/potatoism-vesica-coupling-atlas.json","data/potatoism-deep-extrapolation-atlas.json"]},
    "people":{"label":"People and Dwellers","files":["data/people-registry.json","data/people-seed-records.json","data/blueprints/people-dweller-master.json"]},
    "relational_dynamics":{"label":"Entanglement and Dynamics","files":["data/entanglement.json","data/axis-topology.json","data/tree-child-records.json","data/tree-support-records.json","data/cross-domain-couplings.json"]}
  },
  "navigation":{"home":"index.html","atlas":"repository.html","world":"nations.html","people":"people.html","beliefs":"belief.html","potatoism":"potatoism.html","hawkins":"hawkins.html","record":"node.html?id=<id>","nation":"nation.html?id=<country-id>"},
  "fallback":"If an optional live source fails, local repository-backed data remains authoritative for navigation and available content. Live enrichment is additive.",
  "maintenance_workflow":"data/project-workflow.json",
  "maintenance_rule":"Audit → fix bugs → remove duplicates → lock canonical ownership → validate → ingest sourced data → normalize identities and relationships → model coupling → expose through frontend → update manifests → audit again."
}
